rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the bird, and it can also mean duck as food when the context is clearly culinary.

example.english: We saw a duck in the park.
example.traditional: 我哋喺公園見到一隻鴨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gung1 jyun4 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 aap3

rows.note: Use this when you want to specify the flesh of a duck rather than the animal, especially when discussing food or ingredients.

example.english: The duck meat at this restaurant is very tender.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 aap3 juk6 hou2 nyun6
